topic: second-pass document-only save_document MCP SRS evaluation

subagentReview.commonVerdict: The replacement SRS was directionally sound but needed final cleanup for stale discarded dependencies, optional metadata typing, indexing response shape, forbidden-field conformance, save-to-search E2E coverage, and package-smoke fixture parity.

resolvedFindings.finding: Active OPS-ARCH-005 depended on discarded OPS-ARCH-006.
resolvedFindings.resolution: OPS-ARCH-010 supersedes OPS-ARCH-005 and depends on active OPS-ARCH-009 plus SEC-DOC-003.

resolvedFindings.finding: Active REL-DOC-003 depended on discarded SEC-DOC-002.
resolvedFindings.resolution: REL-DOC-004 supersedes REL-DOC-003 and depends on active SEC-DOC-003.

resolvedFindings.finding: Implementation gate still needed to reference only live active requirements.
resolvedFindings.resolution: CON-ARCH-006 supersedes CON-ARCH-005 and gates implementation on FR-DOC-028, IR-MCP-018, CON-MCP-007, SEC-DOC-003, OPS-ARCH-010, OPS-ARCH-009, and REL-DOC-004.

resolvedFindings.finding: Optional save_document metadata fields lacked explicit types and limits.
resolvedFindings.resolution: IR-MCP-018 defines field-level types and limits for title, project, docName, description, docType, category, documentTags, and gitContextPath.

resolvedFindings.finding: indexing.queued was ambiguous relative to indexing.state.
resolvedFindings.resolution: FR-DOC-028, IR-MCP-018, and CON-MCP-007 remove required queued boolean and use indexing.state plus optional diagnostic-only jobId.

resolvedFindings.finding: Forbidden-field conformance did not fully match the interface requirement.
resolvedFindings.resolution: CON-MCP-007 expands conformance to the full forbidden field list and adds unknown-field behavioral rejection tests.

resolvedFindings.finding: Knowledge-store claim needed explicit retrieval verification.
resolvedFindings.resolution: FR-DOC-028 and OPS-ARCH-009 add save_document -> indexing completion/degraded path -> search_documents/smart_search retrieval fixtures.

resolvedFindings.finding: Package smoke fixtures were not fully aligned with shared redaction fixtures.
resolvedFindings.resolution: OPS-ARCH-009 adds Windows/UNC/POSIX/home/userData/raw gitContextPath/credential/provider/native failure cases.

resolvedFindings.finding: SEC-DOC-003 lacked direct code trace links to raw path emission sites.
resolvedFindings.resolution: SEC-DOC-003 now traces current mcp-save logging/outcome and search_documents compatibility boundary sites.

nextEvaluation: Run a final three-subagent A+ check focused on active requirements only and on absence of active depends_on links to discarded requirements.
